label: VERIFIED
extraction: CrewAI tracing & observability and unified control plane. Tracing: monitor and track AI agents and workflows in real-time including metrics, logs, and traces. Unified control plane: centralized platform for managing, monitoring, and scaling agents and workflows. Two approaches: Crews (autonomy and collaborative intelligence with role-based agents) and Flows (event-driven automations combining precise workflow control, single LLM calls, native Crew support). Agents assigned roles like Researcher, Writer, Critic. Sequential and Hierarchical processes. 58k+ stars. Emphasizes grounding agent answers in real data. Practical tutorials for multi-agent systems fundamentals and advanced implementations.
